nodes.prompt:
TASK: Produce an implementation-ready map for making Ferryx daemon-owned terminal sessions survive GUI restart.
DELIVERABLE: A bounded report with exact file:line citations; identify the current daemon launch path, protocol request/response limitations, direct fallback behavior, socket/lock security seams, and a minimal disjoint write set for daemon process lifecycle plus protocol v2. Include the exact tests that should fail before the fix and exact commands to run after it.
SCOPE: Read only markdown/TERMINAL_SESSION_PERSISTENCE_FUNDAMENTAL_SOLUTION.md, src-tauri/src/main.rs, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, src-tauri/src/daemon/{mod,protocol,server,client,launchd}.rs, src-tauri/tests/daemon_persistence_contract.rs, src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Do not edit any file.
VERIFY: Every claim must cite a current file:line and distinguish observed code from proposed design.
STOP WHEN: Return a concise implementation partition with tests and evidence commands; do not modify files.
